summary_1line: Krishna is exalted as the cosmic source of all existence, and he recounts Durvasa’s extreme test of hospitality to show the power and merit of honoring Brahmanas.

image_candidates.scene_text: The ascetic Durvasa, blazing with fierce energy, whips the chariot while Queen Rukmini, smeared with frumenty, is forced to pull it through the city streets as Krishna calmly follows.
Krishna stands covered head to toe in smeared frumenty as the wild-haired sage Durvasa watches with fiery eyes, testing his patience and devotion.
A cosmic vision of Krishna radiating countless rays while the sun, planets, seasons, and gods emerge from his universal form.
